title: Durable router conversation state and recovery
description: Add provider-neutral conversation records, immutable event persistence, recovery for orphaned sessions, and Python/Rust parity. Preserve session IDs, worktree/branch, ordered messages, log references, and lifecycle transitions.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Confirmed shipped: provider-neutral conversation records (EventType::RouterConversation), immutable event persistence, and orphaned-session recovery (kbs router recover) are implemented in both runtimes (rust/src/router.rs, python/src/kanbus/router_conversation.py), preserving session id, worktree/branch, ordered messages, and lifecycle transitions. Verified live this session recovering kbs-28adb94d and kbs-d9c9ee. Closing.
